dialogues.speaker: Tsoslina
dialogues.text: You see? This thing's super complex. The main body is made of relic fragments from different eras, now quietly fused into a single object.

dialogues.speaker: Tsoslina
dialogues.text: The handle here's real rough-hewn, and that's how you know it's from Miscislav's time. As for the body itself, that's clean, elegant work right there. Court of Pale Star-era for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Tsoslina
dialogues.text: And the finishing touch, the snowflake filigree that fuses the two as one? That's Snezhnaya-era human artisanry, no doubt about it.

dialogues.speaker: Lopushina
dialogues.text: That's true. A closer look indeed shows different styles at play here...

dialogues.speaker: Tsoslina
dialogues.text: Anyway, so later... you gotta claim it's a modern counterfeit to lower the price...

dialogues.speaker: Lopushina
dialogues.text: Why don't you do that yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Tsoslina
dialogues.text: Because Blyushko knows me! Knowing him, he'd multiply the price by two for sure if he knew I was the one looking to buy!
